title: Bumblebee eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#c8e6ff' transform='rotate(-25 38 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='28' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#e0f2ff' transform='rotate(20 56 28)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M34 46 Q50 40 66 46 L66 54 Q50 48 34 54 Z' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <path d='M33 58 Q50 52 67 58 L66 65 Q50 59 34 65 Z' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='12' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='32' r='3' fill='#2d2d2d'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='32' r='3' fill='#2d2d2d'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='31' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='31' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 38 Q50 42 55 38' stroke='#2d2d2d' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='45' y1='23' x2='42' y2='17' stroke='#2d2d2d' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='16' r='2' fill='#2d2d2d'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='23' x2='58' y2='17' stroke='#2d2d2d' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='16' r='2' fill='#2d2d2d'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='35' y1='62' x2='30' y2='72' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='68' x2='40' y2='78' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='68' x2='60' y2='78' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='62' x2='70' y2='72' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: a little flower blossom being held -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='7' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='68' r='4' fill='#ff8fb3'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='68' r='4' fill='#ff8fb3'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='76' r='4' fill='#ff8fb3'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='76' r='4' fill='#ff8fb3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 73 L50 80 L47 74 Z' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <!-- arms holding snack -->
  <path d='M36 58 Q34 66 42 70' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 58 Q66 66 58 70' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
